records.title: Fresh-main workflow-safety PR and XRP ledger exact-head verification
records.note: PR #1379 head 2382a58cebf2828b21023fb54e8fe0bf787665ca, base main 34722b7053c33ea0424d18005da7a8eeebab2147, open/draft/unmerged/mergeable. Exact-head core CI run 41114723070 passed 361 tests and 8 subtests; fail-closed gate run 41114722997 passed and explicitly disabled automatic merging. The PR now covers three main-write paths: scheduled cross-analysis becomes read-only/artifact-only; daily signal-accuracy becomes read-only/artifact-only and legacy score NOT_COMPARABLE; manual Knowledge Signal Cycle pushes outputs to a unique run-specific branch and opens a draft PR, never main. Static safety tests and a pre-publication focused test step are present; the Knowledge Signal Cycle itself was not dispatched. PR #1353 research-ledger metadata head 85d89a983922c9d466daa1e034a1778c9f55c20f passed 19 validator tests in run 41114433645 and fail-closed gate run 41114433629. Main remained unchanged.
